name: Katsura Hinagiku
source:
Likes: Family, studying, cooking, kendo
Dislikes: High places, aircrafts, losing, ghosts, scary stories

Hinagiku is the current student council president, and kendo club president at Hakuou Academy, and an expert with swords, specifically kendo swords.

Hinagiku is very capable in everything. It seems that whatever she turns her hand to, she will excel at it. Despite not being a senior or the most wealthy student, she was elected as president of the student council. She is deeply respected by both her juniors and seniors. In addition to all of that, Hinagiku is admired by many male and female students (due to her beauty and her quality to excel in almost everything). Thus, she is seen and adored as a school idol in Hakuo Academy.

Hinagiku is usually seen by others as possessing heavy masculine qualities, since Hinagiku often acts tough in front of others. However, it can be seen that the reason she acts like this (being tough) is to keep her image as the president of the student council (or of the entire academy as well) who has everything under control.

[From [url=http://hayatenogotoku.wikia.com/wiki/Hayate_The_Combat_Butler_Wiki]Hayate no Gotoku Wiki[/url]]
